recognize_zh: 抹片中滿是小而圓、染色質粗塊狀的成熟小淋巴球，夾雜數個被壓扁的破碎細胞（smudge cells），箭頭指向一顆較大、有核仁的前淋巴球（prolymphocyte），右下為殘存巨核細胞，是 CLL 骨髓抹片典型表現。
features: Predominance of small mature lymphocytes with round nuclei and coarse, block-like clumped chromatin
Scant rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm; nucleoli absent in most cells
Scattered smudge/crushed cells with streaked nuclear material
Occasional larger prolymphocyte with a visible nucleolus (arrow)
Residual megakaryocyte present; other hematopoietic elements markedly reduced
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows marked lymphocytosis composed predominantly of small, mature lymphocytes with round nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm. Smudge cells are scattered throughout, and an occasional larger prolymphocyte with a distinct nucleolus is present (arrow), without a significant prolymphocyte population in this field. A residual megakaryocyte is seen, while granulocytic and erythroid precursors are sparse. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma cells are often more pleomorphic with irregular or notched nuclei and are cyclin D1 positive, CD23 negative.
B-PLL is dominated by medium-sized cells with prominent central nucleoli, whereas here prolymphocytes are rare.
SMZL cells have more abundant cytoplasm, sometimes with polar villous projections, and are usually CD5 and CD23 negative.
